title: Store the library's big WAVs as lossless FLAC
description: 64 WAV samples of 2 MB or more (stems, denoised Library of Congress recordings, excerpts), 1006 MB: encode FLAC beside each, check it decodes identically, repoint Sample.audio (id and path unchanged). Push to the bucket; update production Sample.audio. New stems written as FLAC; migrate labels .flac as audio/flac.
